findings.note: _write_evidence raises EvidenceTargetUncontained and _block consequently emits no Resolver Evidence. This creates a third no-evidence exception beyond the two explicitly allowed by REQ-002/AC-012. The check also rejects a symlink at the final resolver-evidence.yaml component even though os.replace replaces that directory entry rather than following it, so a valid in-tree Evidence destination can be suppressed unnecessarily.

_read_journal verifies only that nonce is a string; it never requires it to equal the containing batch directory name. The transaction contract says the journal records this batch's own nonce, so a mismatched and therefore malformed journal is accepted and acted upon instead of blocking publication-journal-recovery.
